OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

removeOrganization(address).details: Revokes the organization's authorization to use the program factory. Does not      affect already-deployed programs owned by that organization.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: CGRegistry — Directory of all CGOrganization instances

addOrganization(address).notice: Add an existing CGOrganization by address (e.g. to re-add a previously removed org).         Only callable by registry owner. Re-authorizes the org to use the program factory.

createOrganization(string,address).notice: Deploy a new CGOrganization with the given owner. Only callable by registry owner.

removeOrganization(address).notice: Remove an organization from the registry. Only callable by registry owner.

userdoc.notice: Only the registry owner (deployer) can create organizations.
